definitions: to push a sharp object into or through something
to attach something to something else using a sticky substance
to become fixed in one position and be unable to move
to remain in a particular place, job, or situation
to tolerate or endure something unpleasant
examples: She stuck the needle into the fabric.
He stuck a stamp on the envelope.
The door stuck and wouldn't open.
I decided to stick with my current job.
I don't know how you stick it.
